run_backtest_cli: run the backtesting CLI with comma-separated tickers, start/end dates, and initial capital
select_analysts_interactive: select AI analysts interactively via checkbox or pass a comma-separated list via --analysts
run_with_ollama_model: run backtesting using a local Ollama model with the --ollama flag and interactive model selection
run_with_cloud_llm_model: run backtesting using a cloud LLM model with interactive selection from LLM_ORDER
view_backtest_metrics: view backtest results including total return, sharpe ratio, sortino ratio, and max drawdown
